recommended_order.reason: Once imports are clean, mypy sees the real picture. Adding type annotations makes the I/O review safer because you can verify signatures after async conversion.

recommended_order.reason: Converting sync I/O to async is the most invasive change. It ripples through callers. Clean imports (real call graph) and proper types (verified signatures) make this much safer.
recommended_order.resolution: For each sync function doing I/O: if an async sibling already exists, remove the sync version and update callers. Update all callers to await the converted function.
